app.title: LiteBranch
btn.message: Create a lightweight branch from here
pin.heading: {name} · {current} of {total}
actions.unavailable: This message's controls are not loaded. Scroll to the bottom of the chat and try again.
dlg.title: Create a lightweight branch
dlg.intro: Start a fresh, fast chat that keeps only the most recent messages, counting back from the one you picked. Branching does not remove messages from the source chat.
dlg.countHint: How many messages (from the selected one, going back) to copy into the new chat.
dlg.rangeAll: Will copy all {n} messages (the chat is shorter than the requested count).
dlg.summary: Add an AI summary of the older part
dlg.summaryHint: Choose the recent tail or staged processing of all omitted history. The recap becomes the first message of the branch with a navigation pin.
summary.budgetHint: Minimum 500. In staged mode this is the size of each chunk; the previous recap, instructions and SillyTavern context are additional. Characters are not tokens or the model's total context limit.
summary.previewOption: Preview and edit the summary before creating the branch
summary.lorebooksHint: Uses SillyTavern's native activation: matching entries only, subject to keys, the quiet trigger and World Info budget. It does not read every lorebook in full.
summary.coverage: Older messages: {total}. Included: {included}, partially: {partial}. Outside budget: {omitted}. Hidden, system or empty skipped: {skipped}. Characters: {chars}. Requests: {steps}.
summary.edit: Review and edit the recap if needed
summary.empty: The model returned an empty response or the summary text was cleared.
summary.cancelling: Cancelling after the current request finishes…
summary.badBudget: Enter a finite character count of at least 500.
source.failed: Could not open the source chat. It may have been deleted or renamed.
toast.updateRequired: This version of SillyTavern does not expose the required chat API. Please update SillyTavern.
toast.sourceChanged: The source chat or selected message changed. Please start branching again.
toast.savedIncomplete: Branch file saved as {name}, but registration or opening failed. See the console for details.
toast.empty: There are no messages to branch from.
toast.badCount: Enter a number of messages greater than 0.
toast.badAnchor: Choose a valid message to branch from.
toast.busy: A branch is already being created.
toast.failed: Couldn't create the branch. See the console for details.
set.intro: Huge chats (tens of MB) lag hard even when only a few messages are shown. LiteBranch spins off a small, snappy new chat that keeps just the last N messages, so you can keep roleplaying without the lag. Your original chat stays intact as an archive.
set.defaultCountDesc: Pre-filled value in the branch dialog and used by the /litebranch command.
set.askEveryTimeDesc: When off, the message button branches instantly using the default count.
set.showJumpBottomDesc: Shows the round button for jumping to the latest message when the chat is scrolled up.
set.showMessageActionsDesc: A floating button opens the native controls for the last or second-to-last message: edit, copy, delete and extension actions.
set.summaryDefault: Summarize the older part by default
set.summaryDefaultDesc: Pre-checks the summary option in the dialog.
set.summaryPromptHint: Sent to the model with the history. Set the language, structure and details you want preserved here.
set.summaryLimit: Max characters of history to summarize
set.nameTemplateHint: Placeholders: {chat} = source chat name, {date} = timestamp, {mes} = message id.
